# Menelabs.VectorAtlas

> A free, lightweight SVG world map generated from Natural Earth public domain
> data. One `<path>` per country, id-keyed by lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2
> code. Released under CC BY 4.0 (attribution required, commercial use
> allowed).

Use this project when you need an SVG world map for a choropleth, a
"submissions by country" heatmap, or any other SVG-based map UI, and want to
target countries by a standard two-letter code instead of parsing an
unfamiliar id scheme.

## Key facts

- Map data source: Natural Earth `ne_110m_admin_0_countries`, patched with
  `ne_50m_admin_0_countries` for a handful of small nations missing from the
  110m dataset entirely.
- Output file: `dist/world.svg`, one `<path id="xx">` per country, `xx` =
  lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.
- Disputed/unrecognized territories without a standard ISO code (e.g.
  Somaliland) get a synthesized `_name`-style id instead of being dropped.
- Regenerate with `npm install && npm run generate` (source: `scripts/generate.mjs`).
- License: CC BY 4.0. Attribution required for free use; a commercial
  no-attribution license is planned but not yet available.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/melenaos/Menelabs.VectorAtlas/blob/main/README.md): full usage and data source details.
- [Examples](https://github.com/melenaos/Menelabs.VectorAtlas/tree/main/examples): basic embed and choropleth heatmap patterns.
- [Live demo](https://melenaos.github.io/Menelabs.VectorAtlas/): interactive map preview.
